item.title: Version 2.3.2026.03.19
item.description:
What's New in 2.3.2026.03.19

Improvements

  • Shoot reports restored — equipment, ratings, color tags, file sizes, and select thumbnails are back in PDF reports after a regression in 2.2.
  • Folder exclusion redesigned — excluded folders are now chosen via a folder picker scoped to your session, replacing the unreliable auto-scan. Excluded folders appear as orange "⊘ not scanned" entries in the PDF report.
  • Verification Options sheet — folder exclusion and backup verification are now clearly organized in one pre-flight sheet.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed Sparkle auto-update incorrectly reporting "You're up to date" when a newer version was available.
  • Fixed the release script to correctly separate sparkle:version (build number) from sparkle:shortVersionString (display version).
  • Fixed cameras, lenses, ratings summaries, and thumbnails being missing from auto-generated shoot reports.
